qs.q: During which childhood age is onset of acute lymphoblastic leukemia most frequent? ---
qs.e: Peak incidence of childhood ALL is around age 2-5 years.

qs.q: Peak age of onset of acute lymphoblastic leukemia in childhood?
qs.e: ALL has a peak incidence between ages 2–5, making it the most common childhood malignancy.
